title: Wailing Caverns
body: The Wailing Caverns run deep beneath Lushwater Oasis, where the druid Naralex went down to dream the Barrens green and found a nightmare instead. The nightmare has filled the caves he chose. Deviate beasts prowl the winding tunnels and dark pools, ectoplasms ooze through the gloom, and robed Druids of the Fang walk among the beasts unharmed. Somewhere in the depths Naralex still sleeps, and just inside the entrance one of his disciples keeps watch.

parts.body: The deviate beasts rose from beneath the Barrens as Naralex sank deeper into his nightmare, evil yet strangely otherworldly. His disciples are dwindling, too few to cull them alone.

title: Naralex
body: Naralex is a night elf druid who came down into these caverns with an honorable goal: to enter the Emerald Dream and regrow the Barrens into a forest. His focus waned and serpentine visions crept into his thoughts. Now he lies in fitful sleep in a chamber far within, reptilian beasts seep from his dreams into the land, and his disciple warns that unless he is woken he will be lost forever.

parts.body: When the disciple's ritual reached him, Naralex dreamed up a last horror, the murloc Mutanus. With its death he woke, and flew off as an owl to gather his disciples and try again.
sources: npc_text 698 (gossip_menu 201 of Disciple of Naralex 3678: Naralex sleeps again; honorable goal of entering the Emerald Dream and regrowing the Barrens into a lush forest; focus waned, thoughts tainted by serpentine visions; reptilian beasts seep from his dreams to the land; must be awoken or be forever lost and a great evil unleashed)

parts.body: A green shard from the Devourer holds the pure essence of the Emerald Dream, yet the vision within it is a nightmare. In Darnassus a druid looked into it and would say only that the Dream is not what the druids had believed.

title: The Fanglords
body: The Druids of the Fang were part of a noble order that came with Naralex to heal the Barrens. Now they mean to remake that land to match their own twisted dreams, and four Fanglords lead them: Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis, each keeping a lair in the caverns and each holding a dream gem. Pressed hard, they cast off their elven shapes and fight as serpents.

parts.body: Their faces haunt the dreams of the druids of Thunder Bluff, and Nara Wildmane will know no peace until all four are dead.
